args.title: Fix password reset email link to point to the correct URL
args.body:
File: src/api/auth.ts

The password reset email currently links to `http://localhost:3000/reset-password?token=…`. This change updates the link to point to the actual application URL, ensuring that users receive a functional link in their password reset emails.
